process.title: Our Mobile App and Website Development Process

From initial discovery and strategic planning to UI/UX design, development, testing, and deployment, every stage is focused on your business objectives, user experience, and long-term growth.

cta.label: Start with a free discovery call

steps.title: Discovery & Strategy
steps.description: We begin by understanding your business goals, target audience, challenges, and project vision. Our team evaluates your requirements and identifies the right approach to transform your idea into a practical digital solution.

steps.title: Planning & Architecture
steps.description: We turn your requirements into a detailed development roadmap. Our team defines the project scope, selects suitable technologies, establishes milestones, and plans a scalable architecture for your website or mobile application.

steps.title: UI/UX Design
steps.description: We design intuitive, engaging, and user-friendly interfaces that reflect your brand identity. Through wireframes, prototypes, and visual design, we create seamless experiences that help users navigate your website or app effortlessly across devices.

steps.title: Development & Integration
steps.description: Our developers transform approved designs into functional digital products using modern frameworks, reliable coding practices, and scalable architecture. We integrate the required APIs, databases, payment gateways, and third-party services to support your business workflows.

steps.title: Testing & Quality Assurance
steps.description: Before launch, we thoroughly test your website or application to identify issues and improve reliability. Our quality assurance process evaluates functionality, responsiveness, performance, security, and compatibility across supported devices and environments.

steps.title: Launch & Deployment
steps.description: Once your product meets the agreed quality standards, we prepare it for release. Our team configures production environments, deploys your website or application, and supports the launch process to help ensure a smooth transition from development to live operation.

steps.title: Support & Continuous Growth
steps.description: Our partnership continues after launch. We provide ongoing technical support, maintenance, updates, and feature enhancements to help your digital product remain reliable, secure, and aligned with evolving business needs.

items.question: What services does WrathCode Technology offer?
items.answer: We build custom websites, web apps, mobile apps, crypto and blockchain platforms, games and AI-powered software. One team handles design, development, testing and support, so you don't have to juggle multiple vendors.

items.question: Which industries does WrathCode serve?
items.answer: We work with healthcare, fintech, e-commerce, education, crypto, gaming, on-demand services and more. Our team has delivered 550+ projects for clients in 10+ countries, so we've likely solved a problem close to yours.

items.question: Does WrathCode provide custom software development services?
items.answer: Yes. Every product is built around your goals and users, from custom ERP systems and dashboards to full web and mobile platforms. We don't force your idea into a ready-made template.

items.question: How long does WrathCode take to develop an app or software?
items.answer: A simple app typically takes 2–4 weeks. A more complex product with custom features and integrations takes 4–8 weeks. We confirm the exact timeline in the scoping step, once we know what's being built.

items.question: Does WrathCode provide post-launch support and maintenance?
items.answer: Yes. Support is the last step of our process. We help with bug fixes, updates and new features after launch, so your product keeps improving as your business grows.

items.question: How much does it cost to develop a mobile app with WrathCode?
items.answer: The cost depends on features, platforms and complexity, so we don't quote a one-size-fits-all price. After a short discovery call we give you a ballpark figure, then a detailed scope and quote before development begins.

items.question: Which technologies does WrathCode work with?
items.answer: React, Angular, Node.js, Python, PHP, Laravel, CodeIgniter, CakePHP and Microsoft technologies, plus WordPress, Shopify and Magento for content and e-commerce. We recommend the stack that fits your product.

items.question: Can WrathCode build HIPAA-compliant healthcare apps?
items.answer: Yes. We build HIPAA-compliant healthcare apps and have delivered fintech, crypto and e-commerce products where security and data protection matter from day one.
